title: Comparison of 2.2 mm vs. 2.6 mm corneal incisions in phacoemulsification in hard nuclear cataracts: impact on intraoperative energy and postoperative corneal recovery

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Age-related cataract with Emery-Little nuclear hardness grade III-V, age 50-90 years, preoperative ECD at least 2000 cells/mm2; glaucoma, uveitis, corneal endothelial disease, poorly controlled diabetes or diabetic retinopathy and previous ocular surgery excluded

groups.description: Phacoemulsification (Centurion, 45 degree Kelman tip, Viscoat) through a 2.2 mm clear corneal incision with in-the-bag IOL; single surgeon; retrospective cohort
Phacoemulsification (Centurion, 45 degree Kelman tip, Viscoat) through a 2.6 mm clear corneal incision with in-the-bag IOL; single surgeon; retrospective cohort

exclusions.what: Table 5 'Change from baseline' rows (delta at 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months)
exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for both groups; the absolute ECD series are used
Preoperative values are cited from Table 5 so the series comes from one table; Table 2 reports a different SD for the 2.2 mm group, the cited Table 5 cells are used as reported

notes: Two incision sizes of the same standard phacoemulsification technique, no investigational agent: both control-role, separate groups.

Same hospital and author group as ecd-pmc12994532 (stated cohort periods differ: June 2022 - October 2023 retrospective here, August 2024 - August 2025 prospective there). Several change-from-baseline cells of Table 5 here share their SD text with change cells of that article's Table 4; values are recorded as reported and flagged for curator review of possible overlap or reporting error.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative ECD of the operated eye (Table 5 row 'Preoperative'; Methods: EM-3000 specular microscopy preoperatively)
series.notes: Table 5 column '2.2 mm Group (cells/mm2)'; mean ± SD (t-tests/paired t-tests; Table 2 footnote: mean ± standard deviation). Postoperative 1 day = 1/30.4375 and 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative ECD of the operated eye (Table 5 row 'Preoperative'; Methods: EM-3000 specular microscopy preoperatively)
series.notes: Table 5 column '2.6 mm Group (cells/mm2)'; mean ± SD (t-tests/paired t-tests; Table 2 footnote: mean ± standard deviation). Postoperative 1 day = 1/30.4375 and 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.
